title: Configure benchmark jobs on classes and simplify launchers
api_or_output: Every benchmark class carries MemoryDiagnoser and ShortRunJob; launchers do not inject redundant jobs

acceptance.description: Apply explicit [MemoryDiagnoser, ShortRunJob] to every existing unannotated benchmark class in owned experiment/Common/Input/Serializer sources; remove redundant launcher-injected jobs while preserving allocation/ABI/model modes and workload semantics. Existing correctly annotated Tree/Syntax/builder classes remain untouched.

Verify real compiled BenchmarkDotNet discovery yields exactly one intended class-configured job and memory diagnoser for all owned classes, with unchanged case/workload inventory and command-line invocation omitting job arguments; build affected harnesses and preserve allocation/ABI modes.

Preserve all historical verified source/evidence and actual runtime/public API; record checks at known revision, run planning validation and final owned-path audit. New timings are unnecessary if actual job configuration/workload identity is unchanged; do not claim unrun workloads.

handoff.summary: User requests job configuration on benchmark classes, no explicit job arguments or repetitive job-name narration. Narrow infrastructure migration preserves historical reports and runtime.
